create_BatcherIterDataPipe_batch: create a BatcherIterDataPipe that groups elements from an IterDataPipe into mini-batches of specified size
build_BatcherIterDataPipe_drop_last: build a BatcherIterDataPipe with drop_last=True to discard incomplete final batches
test_UnBatcherIterDataPipe_unbatch: test the UnBatcherIterDataPipe unbatch method to flatten nested batched data up to a specified level
create_GrouperIterDataPipe_groupby: create a GrouperIterDataPipe that groups elements by a key function with configurable buffer and group sizes
build_GrouperIterDataPipe_keep_key: build a GrouperIterDataPipe with keep_key=True to yield tuples of group key and grouped items
